findings.quote: placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC
findings.message: The heating step captures temperature but does not preserve placement into a pre-heated block as an unmapped physical action.
The GC/MS completion check before solvent removal is omitted and cannot be expressed by an allowed operation.

findings.quote: dried on an oil bath at 90 oC for 90 minutes
findings.message: The final HeatChill step captures temperature and duration, but the drying action and oil-bath condition should also be preserved in unmapped_actions.

value.evidence: placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC
value.reason: Physical placement into a pre-heated block is not represented by the heating operation; temperature is captured in the reaction HeatChill step.
GC/MS monitoring to judge completion before solvent removal is not represented by an allowed operation.

value.evidence: dried on an oil bath at 90 oC for 90 minutes
value.reason: Drying and the oil-bath condition are not fully represented by HeatChill; temperature and duration are already captured in the final step.
